description: Linux edition profiles for CORE-033 to CORE-037. Status is supported (must pass Linux conformance before release), candidate (may be implemented; not release-blocking until promoted by the product owner), or retired. Toolkit entries marked proposed need product-owner confirmation under D-LIN-002 before the edition's first code.

editions.role: reference edition and fallback for any distribution without a distro-native edition

toolkit.value: Qt 6 Widgets, Qt Quick for settings and history chrome, C++17

mechanisms.capture: xdg-desktop-portal Screenshot and ScreenCast; direct protocols as diagnosed fallbacks

mechanisms.tray: Background portal and status icon where the shell provides one; otherwise an accepted disposition

editions.role: distro-native edition for KDE Plasma distributions

toolkit.value: Qt 6 with KDE Frameworks 6 and Kirigami

editions.role: distro-native edition for Hyprland setups such as Omarchy

toolkit.value: Qt 6 with LayerShellQt or GTK 4 with gtk4-layer-shell; choose one before first code

mechanisms.capture: xdg-desktop-portal-hyprland, with compositor capture protocols as diagnosed fallbacks
mechanisms.global_shortcuts: GlobalShortcuts portal, with documented Hyprland bind integration
mechanisms.tray: StatusNotifierItem where the bar supports it; otherwise an accepted disposition
